learner_operation: Normalize the derivative coefficient, identify P and Q, compute I=exp(integral P dx), and select the unique equation whose product derivative expands to I(y′+Py)=IQ.

fixed_features.feature: Transform the ODE only as far as d(yI)/dx=IQ
fixed_features.justification: Canonical example e-21741 and all eight practice prompts stop at this stage; solving y would add work from the next knowledge point.

fixed_features.feature: Single radio field containing five complete equations
fixed_features.justification: All eight captured practice banks use this response contract. The number of correct selections is fixed by the single-choice task.

fixed_features.feature: Elementary P with nonzero normalization coefficient on the domain
fixed_features.justification: The source requires constant, linear or reciprocal integration and the product rule. Restricting to a valid interval makes division/logarithms legitimate.

answer_roles.role: Integrating factor coefficient/sign and correct choice position
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Small positive/negative constants, fractions and powers, with the correct factor following P; permute answer positions.
answer_roles.observed: Both signs, fractional coefficients and varied positions appear. Controlled +1 to -1 changes I from exp(x) to exp(-x).

answer_roles.role: Which recognizable bank relationship is assigned to the correct factor
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Do not always make the correct factor the uniquely identifiable smaller member of an exponent-doubling pair. Use valid full banks whose superficial roles do not specify the key.
answer_roles.observed: All easy templates fix [I,1/I,I^2,x,x^2]. Thus the correct I is recoverable from the bank alone for every nonzero allowed coefficient.

answer_roles.role: Forcing Q at fixed constant P
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Source canonical permits Q=2exp(-2x); constant-P cosine and polynomial forcings are also observed, with no need to integrate QI.
answer_roles.observed: Easy templates support only Q=cos(bx) or x^n. The canonical exponential-forcing assignment is missing.

counterfactuals.change: Hold signed_constant_power, n=2 and seed=8173 fixed; change a from +1 to -1.
counterfactuals.expected: Prompt coefficient, solution P, integrating factor and correct transformed equation must change together; exp(x) becomes exp(-x).
counterfactuals.observed: Printed equations and all three worked equation rows agree with each new prompt. Native grader accepts each new key and rejects the opposite-sign factor. UI screenshots show the changed signs and correct complete equations.
counterfactuals.justification: P changes the defining condition I′=PI (tutorial a7f8aa2e-e022-57eb-be82-5f539a4512f6).

counterfactuals.change: Keep a=1,n=2 and every mathematical datum fixed; change only shuffle seed from 8173 to 8174.
counterfactuals.expected: The complete correct equation, its owned choice UUID, prompt and worked solution remain identical, while choice order changes.
counterfactuals.observed: Those fields are equal; the ordering differs. Native grader accepts the same key. Rendered first and third previews display the same mathematical task with different choice positions.
counterfactuals.justification: Answer order has no role in the lesson’s product-rule identity. No substantive ODE datum is wholly irrelevant to the complete transformed equation.

shortcut_probes.cue: Unique exponential whose doubled exponent also appears among the other choices
shortcut_probes.strategy: Ignore the ODE. Choose e^h when e^(2h) is also offered.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: Uniform random choice among five options succeeds at rate 0.2; this answer-bank-only rule succeeds on every tested item in the subgroup. The code fixes this relationship for every nonzero easy coefficient. This bypasses identifying P and computing its integrating factor.

delivery.result: Fresh easy samples: 24/24 survive, all predictable, one construction attempt each. Runner batch: 5 becomes 4 after one duplicate, all survivors predictable. All three affected stored easy instances are selectable under applicable easy-band/history scenarios. Original sources also remain in the current pool, so the entire pool is not claimed uniformly predictable.

limitations: Finite tests cannot prove absence of other shortcuts; demonstrated rule applies structurally to all default easy banks.
Policy weights and learner history are not captured. Selection was examined under explicit scenarios using real captured entity IDs, not asserted as a live learner trace.
Inventory conclusions use basis 5319; later inventory can differ. No publication preparation exists, so check_delivery reproduced filtering read-only.
Fresh focus is requested easy; moderate/hard have a small math regression sample, not a comprehensive shortcut audit.
Canonical source has no captured answer field; missing practice keys/solutions and the malformed raw derivative are identified in source-analysis.json.
